title: There's A Place
lyrics_synced:
[00:06.56] There is a place where I can go
[00:11.95] when I feel low, when I feel blue!
[00:19.45] And it's my mind!
[00:23.44] And there's no time when I'm alone!
[00:30.70] I think of you!
[00:34.69] And things you do, go 'round my head!
[00:40.08] The things you said, like "I love only you!"
[00:51.56] In my mind there's no sorrow!
[01:00.47] Don't you know that it's so?
[01:04.22] There'll be no sad tomorrow!
[01:07.97] Don't you know that it's so?
[01:11.72] There'll be no sad tomorrow!
[01:15.94] There, for there's a place,
[01:21.33] where I can go, when I feel low,
[01:28.83] when I feel blue!
[01:32.81] And it's my mind! And there's no time
[01:40.08] when I'm alone!
[01:44.06] Oh there's a place!
[01:47.81] Oh there's a place!
[01:51.56] Oh there's a place!
[01:55.31] Oh there's a place!
[01:59.06] Oh there's a place!
[02:02.81] Oh there's a place!
